scope: Primary documentation supports semantics, not actual feed activation, publication, market depth or production acceptance. Exact chain observations are in the raw RPC captures.

sources.supports: API3 proxy compatibility omits round functionality; integrations relying on rounds require an appropriate adapter. PoPL's current Oracle validates positive coherent rounds.
Stored values can be arbitrarily old. Publish time must be checked and authenticated updates supplied before relying on a current observation.
Robinhood Pyth Core and Pro are separate deployed interfaces; the observed core address is the documented Core address.
Current Pyth Core EVM update fees are zero; this does not remove update gas, data access or publication requirements. Actual zero values were separately read on-chain.
Core integration updates signed prices then reads with a specified maximum age. No price update was performed by this qualification.
Feed users must evaluate source quality, liquidity and concentration risks. A feed address or current positive answer alone is not project acceptance.
StateView exposes current slot0 and active liquidity off-chain. Exact return layouts are pinned to dependency implementations in SOURCE_BINDINGS.json, rather than inferred from documentation prose.
